records.title: Menu for a dinner held for Evie Dennis by the Seoul Olympic Organizing Committee
records.venueText: Menu for a dinner held for Evie Dennis by the Seoul Olympic Organizing Committee
records.creator: Seoul Olympic Organizing Committee
records.descriptionSummary: Menu for a dinner held on Thursday, July 7, 1983 at the Hotel Lotte (Seoul, South Korea). This dinner was held in honor of Dr. Evie Dennis, then Vice President of the U.S. Olympic Committee. Seoul was then preparing to host the 1988 Summer Olympics. Menu is in English and Korean, with a color photograph of a formal Hotel Lotte seating area on the other side.
records.notes: Image of seating area shows gold braided string attached at upper corners.

records.title: National Prepar'dness Tour luncheon menu
records.creator: Colorado Fuel and Iron Corporation
records.descriptionSummary: Menu for the National Prepar'dness Tour by the Thirty-eighth General Assembly of the Pueblo Steel plant hosted by the Colorado Fuel and Iron Corporation (C.F. & I.). The menu provides a brief statement from the C.F. & I. to the visiting legislators and the menu for the luncheon. The front of the menu features a colored illustration of Pikes Peak.
records.notes: There are 3 hole punches on the left side of the menu. The paper is frayed along the right edge of the front page, possibly a stylistic choice.
